_note: WATER-MEANDER-CLAMP-1. Presentation-grade WIDE verdict poses for the mc2_17 water-deletion defect. The pre-existing mc2_17_terrain_near.json 'water_near' pose is alt 320 -- close and blurry; it proves the mechanism but is not what the user sees. These are full-frame shots at normal RTS gameplay altitude (alt 820-900, proj 30-34) so the verdict is judged on the same framing the defect was reported in. Coordinates decoded from the mission .pak MapData packet (side=120, half-extent 7616 wu) with water = elev <= [Water] Elevation = 120; each centres a ~50%-water coastline neighbourhood. mc2_17 is the flat-shelf map: median shore |grad| = 0.101 wu-elev per wu-horizontal, the flattest of the four water maps, which is exactly why the thickness-specified meander amplitude diverges into a ~1785 wu horizontal excursion here and deletes the water body.
